newsitem.title: ABU DHABI: UAE sets up committee to fight price rises.
newsitem.headline: UAE sets up committee to fight price rises.

text.p: The United Arab Emirates is setting up a committee to fight consumer price rises, the official WAM news agency said on Monday.

"In line with President Sheikh Zaid bin Sultan al-Nahayan's orders, it was decided to form a committee to put an immediate end to the continued rise of the prices of foodstuffs and other consumer goods which UAE markets have recently witnessed," a source in the president's office was quoted as saying.
The source said the leadership of the oil-rich UAE had decided to set up strict controls to counter what he called "the greed of traders".
The UAE's inflation is officially estimated at five percent a year but is independently put at 12 percent.
